title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
abstract: arXiv:2608.05136v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Different optimization algorithms can find very different solutions to the same problem. Gradient descent (GD) exhibits a low-rank bias in overparameterized problems when initialized near zero, while Adam does not. GD is rotationally equivariant: rotating both factors of a factored model $W = UV^\top$ by an orthogonal matrix leaves the loss unchanged, and GD's solution rotates accordingly. In contrast, Adam is not. We show that any algorithm using only the current gradient and respecting rotational symmetry amounts to a left-preconditioner depending only on the gradient's Gram matrix. This gives a norm-based test, which passes for the spectral norm in Muon and fails for Adam's $\ell_\infty$ norm. Empirically, nine optimizers fall into groups consistent with the test on underdetermined matrix sensing. Sharing Adam's second moment across coordinates gradually recovers a low-rank bias, and its solutions approach GD's as the stepsize dec

translated_title: 损失函数看不到基，但 Adam 能看到
translated_abstract: 不同的优化算法在同一个问题上可以找到截然不同的解。当初始化接近于零时，梯度下降（GD）在过参数化问题中表现出低秩偏置，而 Adam 则不然。GD 具有旋转等变性：对分解模型 $W = UV^\top$ 的两个因子用正交矩阵进行旋转，损失函数保持不变，GD 的解也随之旋转。相比之下，Adam 不具备这一性质。我们证明，任何仅使用当前梯度且满足旋转对称性的算法，都等价于一个仅依赖于梯度 Gram 矩阵的左预条件子。由此得到一个基于范数的判别测试：Muon 中的谱范数通过该测试，而 Adam 的 $\ell_\infty$ 范数则不通过。在欠定矩阵感知问题上的实证结果显示，九种优化器的分组与该测试的预测一致。在坐标间共享 Adam 的二阶矩可以逐渐恢复低秩偏置，并且随着步长衰减，其解逐渐趋近 GD 的解。
tldr: 论文证明了旋转等变性是梯度下降在过参数化问题中产生低秩偏置的关键机制，而 Adam 因破坏了旋转对称性而不具备该偏置，并提出了一种基于范数的判别测试来预测各优化器的解的分组行为。
